method: Manual visual examination of all 84 exact 420px P87 WebP derivative thumbnails extracted from three GitHub Actions workflow artifacts, organized into seven labeled 4×3 contact sheets. Source semantics were cross-checked against P88 source audit. Does NOT constitute full-resolution review, physical-venue identity proof, or rights clearance.
classification_notes: Off-topic: no image of requested physical church at all; exclude from church review.
Detail-only: retain for future possible gallery, NOT primary image.
Weak: deprioritize and seek stronger exterior photo.
Ambiguous: do not associate to a mass-site pin until exact address/venue identity is established.
Plausible exterior: still research-only and neither approved nor proven to be the Mass venue.
